ability.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
ability.effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.

ability.name: Emberstone Flare
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kharadron Overlords^^** unit that has **^^Fly^^** and is not in combat to be the target.

ability.name: Karst-Bana Aether-Powered Combat Rig
ability.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

ability.name: Spell in a Bottle
ability.effect: This unit can use a **^^Summon^^** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Instead of making a casting roll for that **^^Summon^^** ability, the casting roll is 7 and cannot be modified. That **^^Summon^^** ability cannot be unbound.
